selection: For each task, use seeded random sample of core_ids with nonempty reasoning in all models that expose reasoning. Apply same core_ids to each model. Nonreasoning response text is never substituted for reasoning.
inference: Paired model comparisons by core_id: Wilcoxon signed rank with Holm across all pairs and primary metrics; paired bootstrap CI for median difference. Descriptive Kruskal-Wallis marked dependence-limited. Correctness logit with model, task and log length, cluster SE by core_id. Spearman bootstrap by core_id. Group split classification only secondary.
sensitivity: Exclude longest 1 percent within model; English-only via langdetect; retain all available baseline traces as descriptive check; rolling windows 64/128/256. No causal or monitorability evaluation claim.
optional: No paid APIs or sentence embedding models. Lexical frequency proxy uses wordfreq English and is not a dictionary of valid notation. Surface heuristics do not certify legibility or faithfulness.
